question: Who did Zechariah teach to fear God?

readings.support: Uzziah | who instructed him in the fear of God

assessments.reason: Verse 5 says, “He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God,” where “he/him” refers back to Uzziah in verses 3–4.

reason: The text explicitly states that Zechariah instructed “him” (Uzziah) in the fear of God.
